notes.title: You are not alone
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30245720/2487b1b7034358a26819951b967325677242b491.jpg

Hello, spacemen,  we are happy to announce our next update.

1. Friendly bots are enabled, and now bots know how to use their shields.
2. No more main menu between the levels, you will be transferred automatically to the next map. 
3. Player statistics added. Now you always know how good you are.
4. We have three new crazy items. You will get them for every 100 kills.
5. Old crosshair is finally back (with two more requested by community).
6. Double jumps are smooth, even with high ping.
7. We are testing macOS support now, so you can try it and leave a feedback in community discussions.

Another good news, we have 1000 subscribers in our instagram
https://www.instagram.com/idea.x_cold.space/

notes.title: Custom crosshairs and more!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30245720/edd78c2dbf2ec2547ecc09880e81418acac51a3f.jpg

Hello there, spacemen. It is dangerous to go alone. Take this:

* Custom crosshairs. We've added a few (four) and we will add more later!
* You can turn on mouse invertion. Seems this was the most requested feature! Now it's here!
* Houston! Houston! We have a voice chat! Now spacemans can transmit their voice. Volume can be adjusted in settings. Default key to start a transmition is set to Caps Lock.
* You know that feel when you join a server to find out that game will finish in 8 seconds? Forget about it - server browser now displays remaining time of the match.

notes.title: New Game Mode
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30245720/0c4cf75941e932e9d031b955e3c2ab1eab601043.png

Hello, spacemen.

1. We've added a new game mode called Domination. To win in this game mode your team have to hold the flag as long as you can. Game mode is in beta, but we will improve it, if you like it.

2. Some users are still with 32-bit Windows so we've added support for this OS.

3. Couple of UI bugs, gameplay bugs and crashes reported by our users are also fixed.

notes.title: Linux build goes live
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30245720/a9b229f02e7cec0d870527ab7fda8f2c2757f2ec.jpg

Hello, spacemans.

We've finally updated to latest Unreal Engine and fixed bugs you reported. What do we have now.

1. Game is available on Linux platform. Linux version works only with Nvidia videocards.
2. Borderless mode. Use it if you have green bars all over the screen. It's known issue with Nvidia cards.
2. Resolution scale to control performance in borderless mode.
3. Controls can be reset to defaults. Press it once if you had problems with zoom in/zoom out on mouse wheel.
4. You can disconnect from the game on Choose Team screen.
5. We've added new badge with Tux as common item.
6. Bot's no more counts as active players for server browser.
7. You can setup mouse sensitivity with keyboard.

notes.title: Spawn protection update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30245720/fd83d52daaa39fbeb1023b716b1f64b1a83961be.jpg

Hi all.

We've added spawn protection to our game, to keep you alive for three seconds longer.
It protects you only from bullets, so be careful in close combat, Spacemans!
